subject: Pilot qualification & approval roadmap
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Lara Singh <lara@brightsearch.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot qualification & approval roadmap

Hi Lara — thanks again for a productive conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned. Adding Jonas and Marissa to keep the thread consolidated.

Key pains you described:
- Search relevance drift with current embeddings; high false-positive rate for merchant matches (~20% error).
- Spikes in CPU cost during peak ingestion windows.
- Lack of a reliable canary process for models in prod.

Goals we agreed on:
- Proof-of-concept (PoC) that reduces false-positive rate to <8% for core search intent.
- End-to-end P95 generation latency under 200ms for 256-token requests during pilot.
- Repeatable onramp playbook with clear owners for procurement, security, and production rollout.

Success metrics and acceptance criteria:
- Relevance: F1 improvement of >=12 points on your test set.
- Latency: P95 < 200ms with 95% confidence during pilot traffic profile.
- Ops: Canary + rollback procedure documented and validated.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (attached: Pilot_MAP_v1.xlsx) — high level milestones:
1) Security questionnaire closure / evidence exchange — target: 2027-09-01 (Owner: BrightSearch procurement).
2) PoC kickoff (data access + small ingestion) — target: 2027-09-06 (Owner: Ben / BrightSearch data eng).
3) Mid-PoC review (metrics, first model tuning) — target: 2027-09-20 (Owner: Ben + Lara).
4) Executive review & procurement sign-off — target: 2027-09-30 (Owner: BrightSearch procurement / exec sponsor).
5) Pilot sign-off and SOW to enable production rollout — target: 2027-10-15 (Owner: Marissa / BrightSearch ops).

Immediate asks from you: please confirm the procurement contact (email), whether vendor security review needs to be completed prior to PoC kickoff, and any hard constraints on data residency (US-only / EU).

Notes on licensing/hosting options: Redwood can run the pilot in our hosted environment or in your VPC (private) depending on residency and PHI constraints. I'll include the SOW template and a short note on our KMS/HSM options in the next message.

Attachments: Pilot_MAP_v1.xlsx (working draft)

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

From: Lara Singh <lara@brightsearch.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@brightsearch.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot qualification & approval roadmap

Ben — appreciate the recap and clear milestones. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement timeline: our legal/procurement window is tight in September; procurement lead (procurement@brightsearch.com) needs the vendor security questionnaire complete by 2027-09-01 to stay on track for a 9/30 PO.
- Security: we need SOC 2 Type II evidence and confirmation that encryption at rest + in transit is enabled. For the PoC, we prefer a VPC deployment if PHI is involved — can Redwood support a VPC-hosted pilot with customer-managed keys?
- Data residency: primary data is US-based; however, we have a small EU dataset (10% of corpus) that must remain in EU regions for GDPR-limited fields. Is the pilot able to partition by region?

Also — who will be the exec sponsor on your side for procurement discussions? If we can get sponsor alignment this week, we can set an internal review slot for 2027-08-20.

Thanks,
Lara
Lara Singh | Head of Product | BrightSearch
lara@brightsearch.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Lara Singh <lara@brightsearch.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@brightsearch.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 16:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot qualification & approval roadmap

Thanks Lara — good questions. Short answers first, then an updated plan attached.

Security & compliance:
- SOC 2 Type II: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in 2026; we can share the attestation and the mapping document for the questionnaire.
- Encryption & KMS: we support AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit. For private deployments we integrate with customer KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and can support HSM-backed keys if required.
- VPC/private pilot: yes, we routinely run pilots inside a customer VPC with customer-controlled endpoints; that will satisfy PHI constraints for the pilot.
- Data residency/partitioning: we can partition processing by region. For your EU-only dataset we can keep processing in our EU region and only replicate aggregated metrics back to US-hosted dashboards. We'll include this in the technical appendix.

Procurement & timeline:
- We can meet the 2027-09-01 evidence deadline for the vendor questionnaire; Ben will send the completed questionnaire pack by 2027-08-18.
- Suggested PO target: 2027-09-30 (matches your internal window).

Updated MAP and SOW: attaching updated Pilot_MAP_v1.xlsx (dates + owners adjusted) and SOW-template.pdf for legal. See the revised milestone owners below: 
- Security questionnaire: BrightSearch procurement (procurement@brightsearch.com) — target: 2027-09-01
- PoC kickoff: Ben Carter (Redwood) & BrightSearch data eng — target: 2027-09-06
- Mid-PoC tuning: Ben & Lara — target: 2027-09-20
- Exec review / PO: BrightSearch exec sponsor & Marissa (Redwood CS) — target: 2027-09-30
- Production SOW sign: Legal teams — target: 2027-10-15

Commercial note / ask:
- To keep the PoC low friction we can offer a 30% pilot credit on hosted platform usage for the initial 6-week PoC (subject to standard T&Cs). If BrightSearch prefers VPC, we will need a small reserved capacity commitment to guarantee latency SLOs; we can discuss exact numbers in the SOW.

Internal prep (internal note for the Redwood team): Marissa will lead onboarding and production readiness; Ben will own the PoC execution. Jonas will join the exec sponsor call for procurement if needed.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Ben sends completed vendor questionnaire + evidence bundle by 2027-08-18.
2) We schedule a 30-minute exec sponsor intro call the week of 2027-08-23 to align on PO owner and sign-off criteria.
3) Procurement confirms if additional legal terms (data processing addendum) are required prior to PoC kickoff.

Attachments: Pilot_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), SOW-template.pdf

Best,
Jonas Weber | Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 617-555-0147

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Lara Singh <lara@brightsearch.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@brightsearch.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 18:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot qualification & approval roadmap

Thanks team — quick confirmation from Redwood CS: we can support a VPC-hosted pilot with customer KMS and partitioned EU processing. I will draft a one-page onboarding checklist (data access, credentials, runbook) and have it to you by 2027-08-18.

Request for BrightSearch: can you confirm the exec sponsor contact and whether procurement needs any additional legal guardrails (e.g., DPA) before 9/1? Once we have that, Ben and I will lock the kickoff date.

Also flagging internally that if BrightSearch signs up for VPC reserved capacity, pricing will require an exception to standard hosted pilot credits — I can surface the discount request to pricing and loop back in 24 hours.
